# review — judgement router

> Boundary: `freebuff-patch-check` is NOT here — it is the startup/patch
> ritual and stays top-level. This router is about evaluating work, not
> environment health.
>
> Removed 2026-09-19 by owner order: rejudge, rejudge-diff, cross-eval
> (external LLM validation APIs). Skills must not consume external
> validation services — verify locally (tests, typecheck, manual probing);
> for an independent second opinion ask the owner per run.

## Choosing a part

| Situation | Part |
|---|---|
| Harsh critique of code or writing ("roast it") | `parts/roast/` (132K) |
| Challenge an assumption or plan adversarially | `parts/challenge/` |
| Check work from a human user's perspective | `parts/human-review/` (258K), `parts/think-like-human/` |
| Reflect on what went wrong / right after a task | `parts/self-reflection/`, `parts/reflect/` (128K) |
| Extract lessons into memory after outcomes | `parts/self-learning/` |
| Verify claimed work is actually done | `parts/verify/` |
| Debug a reported bug systematically | `parts/diagnosing-bugs/` |
| Prepare or respond to a review request | `parts/review-request/` |

## Rules

- Load only the parts the task needs; do not dump the whole router into context.
- Heavy parts (roast, human-review, reflect) are complete methods — read
  them fully when opened, skim the router table only for choosing.
- Verification is local-first: a part must never reach for an external
  API to "confirm" work; that pattern was banned 2026-09-19.
